agile projects can be successful if they are implemented in the right environment, and if they are managed by the right people.

, in order for agile project success to be achieved, the following factors must be present: (1) A culture of trust and respect must exist within the organization; (2) The customer and stakeholders must be actively involved in the project; (3) The project team must be involved and buy in to the agile approach; (4) The project must be a suitable type for an agile approach; (5) The team structure, and team logistics must be conducive to agile project delivery.
